product_one_liner.value: Alice provides AI security and safety tools—including red teaming, runtime guardrails, and adversarial-intelligence monitoring—to foundation-model teams, enterprises, and user-generated-content platforms.
product_one_liner.notes: Company description and product overview identify these customer groups and lifecycle safeguards.

pricing_page.notes: The site directs visitors to book a demo or contact sales; its navigation and footer provide no pricing link and the contact page does not publish prices or plans.

named_customers.notes: These organizations are named on Alice's case-studies page; partners and investors were not used as customer evidence.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees (and shows 461 employee profiles).

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies New York as the company's headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Startup Nation Finder identifies Alice (formerly ActiveFence) as founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The company's Engineering @ Alice publication has multiple technical posts on data infrastructure, API/model-backed moderation at scale, and performance testing.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes multiple product guides, integration guides, getting-started materials, and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current listings include Senior GenAI Safety Researcher, GenAI Security Researcher, Principal Data Scientist, and Senior AI Engineer.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed Alice's public docs, product/LLM information, integrations, blog, and privacy information; these describe supported integrations and external collaborations but do not state which model or provider Alice's product itself uses.

compliance_certs.notes: Alice explicitly says it is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified. Other frameworks listed are compliance alignment, not certifications.

last_funding.notes: Alice announced the $140 million round on August 25, 2026; Dealroom identifies it as Series D.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 funding announcement falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers page lists open roles, but none is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index includes an October 21, 2026 launch of an open safety dataset and model post-training work, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete leadership roster is small and lists no executive as a recent joiner; the identified executive-role appointment report is dated 2022, and no departure or C-level/VP change within the 12-month window was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integrations page and public documentation name AI platforms and frameworks but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
